speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are here for a chronic cough and recurrent bronchitis. To begin, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and do you currently smoke or have a history of smoking?

speaker: Patient
text: 51-year-old woman. The patient has been experiencing an aggressive cough producing copious amounts of thick, foamy, yellow-green sputum for about 11 years, with exacerbations similar to the current presentation today.
